Synopsis:
    Peru is in late-stage free trade agreement negotiations with India, hoping to sign a deal in 2027. India has surpassed the US as Peru's second-largest export destination this year, driven by a 152% surge in gold shipments. Peru targets record exports exceeding $100B in 2026. US tariffs introduced in July are pressuring Peruvian agricultural exports; bilateral negotiations are ongoing, with Peru's leadership set to raise the issue at the UN General Assembly.
